activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Khansela unomphela ukulethwa okuseleyo kwalo msebenzi? Lokhu kungeke kuqhutshekwe. Ama-imeyili aselayini lezaziso esezilethiwe kakubuyiswa.
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Khansela zonke izaziso ezisalindile zemisebenzi emidala kulamalanga amangaki?
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Lesi saziso sitshintshile selokhu salayishwa. Hlola isimo esivuselelweyo ungakazami futhi.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Kakukwazekanga ukuqinisekisa isilungiselelo sokulethwa. Vuselela uhlole isimo saso sakhathesi.
activity-recovery-denied: Imvumo yowamukelayo loba okuthandwayo kwezaziso kakusavumeli ukulethwa.
activity-recovery-description: Izaziso ezingaqediwanga ziyazanywa futhi ngokuzenzakalela. Hlola imisebenzi engekho loba etshintshiweyo ungakazami futhi. Ukuzama futhi kakuloku kudali kabutsha umsebenzi.
activity-recovery-failed: Kakukwazekanga ukuqeda ukulethwa kwezaziso. Umsebenzi olindileyo ugciniwe.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Umsebenzi wokuqala kawukho loba utshintshile. Kakulalutho oludalwe kabutsha.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Hluza amalanga amakhadi usebenzisa @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt kumbe @listEnteredAt. Isibonelo: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' kumbe @endAt = none. Faka ibizo lendawo ozenzele yona eliqala ngo-@ phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna.
advanced-filter-description: Isihlungi esithuthukileyo sivumela ukubhala umbhalo olalezi zisebenzisi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Isikhala sisetshenziswa ukwehlukanisa izisebenzisi. Ungahlunga zonke izinkambu ezenziwe ngokwezifiso ngokubhala amabizo lamanani azo. Isibonelo: Field1 == Value1. Qaphela: Nxa izinkambu loba amanani elezikhala, kumele uwafake phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna ezilodwa. Isibonelo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ukweqa izimpawu zokulawula ezilodwa (' /), ungasebenzisa \. Isibonelo: Field1 == I\'m. Ungahlanganisa futhi izimo ezinengi. Isibonelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngokujwayelekileyo zonke izisebenzisi zihunyutshwa kusukela kwesobunxele kuye kwesokudla. Ungatshintsha ukuhlelwa ngokufaka izibaya. Isibonelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ungasesha futhi izinkambu zombhalo nge-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
avatar-too-big: Isithombe somsebenzisi sikhulu kakhulu (__size__ ubukhulu obuphezulu)
avatars-upload-blocked-description: Vimba abasebenzisi ekulayisheni izithombe ezintsha zabasebenzisi (kuyanceda nxa izithombe zivumelaniswa zivela komunye umthombo). Izithombe zabasebenzisi zivunyelwe ngokuzenzakalela.

blockly-ARIA_LABEL_REMOVE_ELSE_IF: Susa umbandela othi nxa kungenjalo nxa
blockly-CANNOT_DELETE_VARIABLE_PROCEDURE: Kungeke kususwe okuguqukayo '%1' ngoba kuyingxenye yencazelo yefankjini '%2'
blockly-COLOUR_RGB_TOOLTIP: Dala umbala ngobunengi obuqondiweyo bokubomvu, okuluhlaza lokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Wonke amanani kumele abe phakathi kuka-0 lo-100.
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_TOOLTIP: Yeqa okuseleyo kwalo mjikelezo, uqhubeke lomjikelezo olandelayo.
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_WARNING: Isixwayiso: Le bhuloki ingasetshenziswa phakathi komjikelezo kuphela.
blockly-CONTROLS_FOREACH_TOOLTIP: Entweni ngayinye ohlwini, beka okuguqukayo '%1' kube yinto leyo, ubusenza imilayezo ethile.

blockly-CONTROLS_IF_IF_TOOLTIP: Engeza, susa, loba uhlele kabutsha izingxenye ukuze ulungise kabutsha le bhuloki ka-nxa.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_1: Nxa inani liliqiniso, yenza imilayezo ethile.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_2: Nxa inani liliqiniso, yenza ibhuloki yokuqala yemilayezo. Kungenjalo, yenza ibhuloki yesibili yemilayezo.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_3: Nxa inani lokuqala liliqiniso, yenza ibhuloki yokuqala yemilayezo. Kungenjalo, nxa inani lesibili liliqiniso, yenza ibhuloki yesibili yemilayezo.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_4: Nxa inani lokuqala liliqiniso, yenza ibhuloki yokuqala yemilayezo. Kungenjalo, nxa inani lesibili liliqiniso, yenza ibhuloki yesibili yemilayezo. Nxa kungekho nani eliliqiniso, yenza ibhuloki yokucina yemilayezo.
blockly-CONTROLS_WHILEUNTIL_TOOLTIP_UNTI: Lapho inani lingamanga, yenza imilayezo ethile.
blockly-CONTROLS_WHILEUNTIL_TOOLTIP_WHIL: Lapho inani liliqiniso, yenza imilayezo ethile.

blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_FLYOUT_LABEL_HINT: Sebenzisa izinkinobho zemicibisholo ukuya kubhuloki, loba ucindezele %1 ukuya esihlokweni esilandelayo.

blockly-LISTS_CREATE_WITH_CONTAINER_TOOL: Engeza, susa, loba uhlele kabutsha izingxenye ukuze ulungise kabutsha le bhuloki yohlu.

blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_GT: Buyisela iqiniso nxa okufakwayo kokuqala kukhulu kulokwesibili.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_GTE: Buyisela iqiniso nxa okufakwayo kokuqala kukhulu kulokwesibili loba kuyalingana lakho.

blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_LTE: Buyisela iqiniso nxa okufakwayo kokuqala kuncane kulokwesibili loba kuyalingana lakho.

blockly-LOGIC_OPERATION_TOOLTIP_OR: Buyisela iqiniso nxa okungenani okukodwa kokufakwayo kuliqiniso.

blockly-MATH_ARITHMETIC_TOOLTIP_POWER: Buyisela inombolo yokuqala iphakanyiselwe emandleni enombolo yesibili.
blockly-MATH_ATAN2_TOOLTIP: Buyisela i-arctangent yendawo (X, Y) ngamadigri kusuka ku -180 kusiya ku-180.
blockly-MATH_CONSTANT_TOOLTIP: Buyisela okukodwa kokungaguquki okujwayelekileyo: π (3.141…), e (2.718…), φ (1.618…), sqrt(2) (1.414…), sqrt(½) (0.707…), loba ∞ (okungapheliyo).
blockly-MATH_CONSTRAIN_TOOLTIP: Vimbela inombolo ukuthi ibe phakathi kwemikhawulo eqondiweyo (kuhlanganisa leyo).
blockly-MATH_IS_TOOLTIP: Hlola nxa inombolo ihlanganayo, ingahlanganiyo, iyinhloko, iphelele, ingaphezu kukazero, ingaphansi kukazero, loba nxa iyehlukaniseka ngenombolo ethile. Ibuyisela iqiniso loba amanga.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_AVERAGE: Buyisela isilinganiso (i-arithmetic mean) samanani ezinombolo ohlwini.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MODE: Buyisela uluhlu lwento (lezinto) evame kakhulu ohlwini.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_SUM: Buyisela isamba sazo zonke izinombolo ezisohlwini.
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_FLOAT_TOOLTIP: Buyisela ingxenyana engakhethwanga phakathi kuka-0.0 (kuhlanganisiwe) lo-1.0 (kungahlanganiswanga).

blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TOOLTIP: Buyisela inombolo ephelele engakhethwanga phakathi kwemikhawulo emibili eqondiweyo, kuhlanganisiwe.
blockly-MATH_ROUND_TOOLTIP: Qunta inombolo kusiya phezulu loba phansi.

blockly-PROCEDURES_CALL_DISABLED_DEF_WAR: Kungeke kuqaliswe ifankjini '%1' echazwe ngumsebenzisi ngoba ibhuloki yencazelo ivaliwe.

blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_WARNING: Isixwayiso: Le bhuloki ingasetshenziswa phakathi kwencazelo yefankjini kuphela.
blockly-PROCEDURES_MUTATORCONTAINER_TOOL: Engeza, susa, loba uhlele kabutsha okufakwayo kule fankjini.

blockly-SCREENREADER_HINT: Sebenzisa izinkinobho zemicibisholo ukuhamba. Cindezela %1 ukuvula loba ukuvala indlela yesifundi sesikrini.
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_DISABLED: Indlela yesifundi sesikrini ivaliwe, cindezela %1 ukuyivula

blockly-TEXT_CHANGECASE_TOOLTIP: Buyisela ikhophi yombhalo ngohlobo olwehlukileyo lwezinhlamvu.
blockly-TEXT_COUNT_TOOLTIP: Bala ukuthi umbhalo othile uvela kangaki phakathi komunye umbhalo.
blockly-TEXT_CREATE_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Engeza, susa, loba uhlele kabutsha izingxenye ukuze ulungise kabutsha le bhuloki yombhalo.
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FIRST: thola ingxenye yombhalo kusuka ohlamvini lokuqala
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_EN: thola ingxenye yombhalo kusuka ohlamvini # kusuka ekucineni
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisela inombolo yendawo yokuvela kokuqala/kokucina kombhalo wokuqala embhalweni wesibili. Ibuyisela %1 nxa umbhalo ungatholakalanga.
blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisela iqiniso nxa umbhalo onikiweyo ungelalutho.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Dala ingxenye yombhalo ngokuhlanganisa noma yiliphi inani lezinto.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisela inani lezinhlamvu (kuhlanganisa izikhala) embhalweni onikiweyo.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Phrinta umbhalo oqondiweyo, inombolo loba elinye inani.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Thathela indawo konke ukuvela kombhalo othile phakathi komunye umbhalo.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Buyisela ikhophi yombhalo izikhala zisusiwe ekucineni okukodwa loba kokubili.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Okuguqukayo okuqanjwe ngokuthi '%1' sekukhona kolunye uhlobo: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Okuguqukayo okuqanjwe ngokuthi '%1' sekukhona njengepharamitha kufankjini '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Dinga endaweni yokusebenzela. Cindezela Enter ukuthola okufanayo okulandelayo, Shift+Enter ukuthola okufanayo okungaphambili. Cindezela Escape ukuvala ukudinga lokugxila kokufanayo kwakhathesi.
bots-none: Akukabi lamabhoti. Ibhoti yisiqhubi kuseva yakho - umsebenzeli we-AI, umsebenzi we-CI, iskripthi - lelibhodi elinikela kuyo amakhadi.
card-archive-pop: Ikhadi alisayikubonakala kulolu luhlu ngemva kokulihambisa eNgobweni yomlando.
card-archive-suggest-cancel: Ungalibuyisela ikhadi eNgobweni yomlando ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: I-Cloud Panel ngeka-SuperAdmin kuphela, kudomeni ye-Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Nge-WeKan ku-Weddy, i-Cloud Panel isebenzela amadomeni amanengi e-WeKan kusuka kuseva eyodwa, ngalinye lilemininingwane yalo. Kudomeni ye-Cloud Panel, u-SuperAdmin uphatha amadomeni le-CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ngekhiye ye-CloudFlare API, idomeni elizone yalo isekhawuntini yakho ye-CloudFlare lithola irekhodi le-DNS elidlula nge-proxy kanye lesitifiketi se-CloudFlare Origin. Amanye amadomeni athola isitifiketi se-Let's Encrypt. Ikhiye igcinwa kuseva njalo kayisoze iphinde itshengiswe.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Kakulakhiye ye-CloudFlare API egciniweyo: idomeni ngalinye lithola isitifiketi se-Let's Encrypt.
confirm-checklist-delete-popup: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukususa uluhlu lokuhlola?

csv-mapping-custom-fields: Amanye amakholamu okungeniswa njengezikhala zakho zombhalo:

csv-mapping-list-missing: Ifayili kayilakholamu yohlu. Khetha eyodwa ngaphezulu, loba ubhale ibizo lohlu olulodwa lapho wonke amakhadi aya khona.
csv-mapping-list-required: Bhala ibizo lohlu lapho wonke amakhadi aya khona, loba ukhethe ikholamu ephethe uluhlu.

email-recovery-busy: Ukuthumela kumbe omunye umsebenzi womzila kuyaqhubeka. Vuselela njalo uzame futhi ngemva kwesikhatshana.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khansela yonke imilayezo esemzileni khathesi yalumamukeli? Okuqukethwe yiyo kuzasuswa njalo ngeke kubuyiselwe. Imilayezo emitsha eyenziwe ngemva kwalesi sicelo izagcinwa.
email-recovery-description: Umugqa owodwa kumamukeli ngamunye. Dinga nge-ID yomsebenzisi. Okuqukethwe yimilayezo lezindawo ze-imeyili yomamukeli akuboniswa. Ukumisa okwesikhatshana kubamba imilayezo ekhona lezayo; ukuqhubeka kuzama ukuthumela imilayezo esemzileni khathesi. Ukukhansela kususa imilayezo efakwe emzileni kuze kube yisikhathi sesicelo. Nxa ukuthumela kuqhubeka, zama futhi ngemva kwesikhatshana. Umlayezo osuqalisile ukuthunyelwa awungeke ubuyiselwe emuva, njalo ukuthumela okungaqinisekanga kungaphindwa. Ukwehluleka okungapheliyo lemilayezo esifinyelele emkhawulweni wokuzama kugcinelwa ukuhlolwa. Ukuzama futhi imilayezo eyehlulekileyo kuqalisa umjikelezo omutsha wokuzama njalo kugcina ukumiswa okwesikhatshana okukhona.
email-recovery-empty: Akulamlayezo osemzileni kumbe abamukeli abamiselwe ukuthumela okwesikhatshana.
email-recovery-failed: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Vuselela umzila njalo uzame umsebenzi ofanayo futhi nxa kudingeka.
email-recovery-superseded: Isenzo esitsha somsebenzisi wohlelo sithathe indawo yalesi sicelo. Kuboniswa umumo womzila wakhathesi.
email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwaniseki ukubala umzila wama-imeyili. Hlola imvumo yomlawuli lokutholakala kweseva.
email-resetPassword-text:
Sawubona __user__,

Ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho, chofoza isixhumanisi esingezansi.

__url__

Siyabonga.
email-verifyEmail-text:
Sawubona __user__,

Ukuqinisekisa i-imeyili ye-akhawunti yakho, chofoza isixhumanisi esingezansi.

__url__

Siyabonga.
error-json-schema: Idatha yakho ye-JSON ayilalo ulwazi olufaneleyo ngendlela efaneleyo
error-user-notSameOrgOrTeam: Ungengeza abasebenzisi abavela eNhlanganweni loba eQenjini elifanayo kuphela
filter-on-desc: Uhlunga amakhadi kuleli bhodi. Chofoza lapha ukuhlela isihlungi.
import-attachment-auth-hint: Okuthunyelwe ngaphandle kubiza amabizo okunamathiselweyo kodwa akuphathi amafayela. Ukuwaletha, nika ikheli lensizakalo lokungena: kusetshenziswa kulokhu kungenisa kuphela, kuthunyelwa kulelo kheli kuphela, njalo akulondolozwa. Tshiya kungelalutho ukungenisa ngaphandle kwamafayela.
import-attachment-auth-token: Ithokheni ye-API, ikhiye ye-API kumbe iphasiwedi ye-app
import-board-instruction-asana: Namathisela i-JSON ekhishwe emisebenzini ye-Asana ({ "data": [...] } evela ekukhitshweni kwe-Asana loba GET /tasks). Imisebenzi ihlelwa ngezigaba (memberships); eqediweyo iya ku-Qediwe.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: KuBusinessmap (owayesakuthiwa yiKanbanize), vula Advanced Search, khetha Configure results ukuze ukhethe amakholamu, ulande ifayili ye-Excel, ubusukhetha leyo fayili ye-.xlsx. Amakholamu afundwa ngamabizo awo esiNgisi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): nxa i-akhawunti yakho isebenzisa olunye ulimi, qamba kabutsha umugqa wezihloko ngesiNgisi kuqala. I-Column iba yizinhlu le-Lane iba yimizila; abanikazi, amathegi, umbala, amalanga, amazwana lamalinki abazali kugcina izindawo zakho, njalo i-Priority, i-Size, i-Type lamanye amakholamu aba yizikhala zakho.
import-board-instruction-clickup: KuClickUp, thumela imisebenzi njenge-CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, loba ukuthumela kombono we-List loba we-Table lawo wonke amakholamu), ubusunamathisela i-CSV. Izimo ziba yizinhlu, izinhlu zeClickUp ziba yimizila, lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi lemisebenzi yawo emincane, abanikwe umsebenzi, amathegi, amalanga, okuqakathekileyo lesikhathi.
import-board-instruction-csv: Namathisela amanani ahlukaniswe ngamakhoma (CSV) / amanani ahlukaniswe ngamathebhu (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Namathisela i-JSON yebhodi le-NextCloud Deck (ibhodi elama-"stacks", isitaki ngasinye silama-"cards"). Izitaki ziba yizinhlu, amakhadi abe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetha ithebula le-.xlsx ngendlela ye-WeKan (amakholomu afanayo lokukhitshwa kwe-Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Umugqa wokuqala uyisihloko.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Khipha ifayela le-.boardarchive endaweni ecindezelweyo ubusukunamathisela okuse-board.jsonl yebhodi, lomugqa wenguqulo kumbe ngaphandle kwawo. Uphawu lokuqoqela emaqenjini ekubonweni kwebhodi luba yizinhlu, ezinye impawu zokukhetha ziba ngamalebula, izingxenye zombhalo lamabhokisi okumaka ziba yincazelo loluhlu lokuhlola, njalo imibono iyagcinwa. Imifanekiso lokunamathiselweyo akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-issues: Namathisela uhlu lwe-JSON lwezinkinga ze-__sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Izinkinga ziba ngamakhadi ahlelwe kuzinhlu Ezivuliweyo / Ezivaliweyo.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Namathisela i-JSON ekhishwe ku-Kanboard: into elama-"columns" (loba imisebenzi ele-column_name) kanye lohlu lwe-"tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Amakholomu aba yizinhlu, imisebenzi ibe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-kanri: KuKanri, vula Import & Export ukhethe Export individual board (loba Export all data), ubusunamathisela ifayili ye-.json. Amakholamu aba yizinhlu lamakhadi aba ngamakhadi, lencazelo yawo, ilanga lokucina, amathegi lemibala; imisebenzi yekhadi iba luhlu lokuhlola. Ekuthumeleni yonke idatha kungeniswa ibhodi yokuqala.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namathisela isakhiwo se-Leo (ifayela le-.leo). Izingxenye ezisezingeni eliphezulu ziba yizinhlu, izingxenye ezingaphansi kwazo ngokuqondileyo ziba ngamakhadi, umbhalo wengxenye ube yincazelo yekhadi. Izingxenye ezisemazingeni ajulileyo ziba yizinhlu zokuhlola. Izingxenye eziphawuliweyo zingeniswa njengeziqediweyo.
import-board-instruction-linear: KuLinear, thumela izindaba njenge-CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, loba ukuthumela kombono), ubusunamathisela i-CSV. Izimo ziba yizinhlu, amaqembu aba yimizila, lezindaba ziba ngamakhadi lonikwe umsebenzi, amalebula, amalanga, indaba engumzali, okuqakathekileyo, isilinganiso, iphrojekthi lomjikelezo.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namathisela uhlu lwemisebenzi lwe-markdown (indlela ezisetshenziswa amathulusi e-markdown-kanban afana ne-Obsidian Kanban): izihloko ze "## Ibizo lohlu", nezinto ze "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ngaphansi. Izihloko ziba luhlu bese izinto ziba amakhadi.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: KuMeisterTask, chofoza ibizo lephrojekthi, khetha Export project uthumele i-CSV, ubusuyinamathisela. Izigaba ziba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, lamanothi ayo, ilanga lokucina, onikwe umsebenzi lamathegi; imisebenzi eqediweyo igcina ilanga layo lokuqediwa. I-CSV ebhalelwe ukungenisa kukaMeisterTask uqobo layo layo iyasebenza.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ku-monday.com, vula imenyu yebhodi, khetha More actions lo-Export board to Excel (lezibuyekezo lezinto ezincane nxa uthanda), ubusukhetha leyo fayili ye-.xlsx. Ikholamu ye-Status iba yizinhlu lamaqembu aba yimizila; abantu, amalanga, umugqa wesikhathi lamathegi kugcina izindawo zakho, amanye amakholamu aba yizikhala zakho lezibuyekezo ziba ngamazwana.
import-board-instruction-notion: KuNotion, vula idathabheyisi njengekhasi eligcweleyo, khetha ••• lo-Export, khetha Markdown & CSV, ukhethe ifayili ye-.zip eyilandayo, loba i-CSV eyodwa yedathabheyisi kuyo, loba unamathisele leyo CSV. Ikholamu ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Status iba yizinhlu (nxa ingekho, ikholamu yokuqala ekhangeleka njengokukhetha iba yizo, njalo umbiko wokungenisa uyatsho ukuthi yiyiphi); imigqa iba ngamakhadi lesihloko sawo, amathegi njengamalebula, abantu njengamalunga, amalanga, lombhalo wekhasi njengencazelo; amanye amakholamu aba yizikhala zakho. Ubudlelwano, imifanekiso lokunamathiselweyo kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: KuNullboard, vula ibhodi, khetha Export this board... kumenyu, vula ifayili ye-.nbx kusihleli sombhalo unamathisele okuphakathi kwayo. Izinhlu ziba yizinhlu lamanothi aba ngamakhadi: umugqa wokuqala wenothi yisihloko sekhadi lokunye kuyincazelo yalo. Inothi engaphekwanga ithola ilebula ethi raw. Ifayili elamabhodi amanengi ingenisa ibhodi yayo yokuqala.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: KuObsidian, vula ifayili yebhodi yeKanban njenge-Markdown (loba uvule ifayili ye-.md kusihleli sombhalo), ubusunamathisela yonke. Imizila iba yizinhlu lemikhawulo yamakhadi azo, amakhadi agcina amathegi awo, amalanga, okuqakathekileyo, izikhala lohlu lokuhlola, njalo i-Archive iba ngamakhadi asengobweni yomlando.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Namathisela i-JSON yeqoqo lemisebenzi ye-OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Izimo ziba yizinhlu, imisebenzi ibe ngamakhadi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Namathisela uhlaka lwe-OPML, njengalokhu iWorkflowy, iDynalist, iOmniOutliner, iLogseq lezinye izinhlelo zohlaka ziluthumela. Izinto zezinga eliphezulu ziba yizinhlu, abantwana bazo baba ngamakhadi lenothi njengencazelo, lezinto ezijulileyo ziba yizinhlu zokuhlola. Izinto eziqediweyo zingeniswa ziqediwe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Namathisela ifayili ye-Org mode, njengalokhu iEmacs, iOrgzly loba iBeorg iyibhala. Izihloko zezinga eliphezulu ziba yizinhlu lezihloko zezinga lesibili ziba ngamakhadi. I-TODO le-DONE, okuqakathekileyo, amathegi, i-SCHEDULED, i-DEADLINE le-CLOSED kuyagcinwa, lamabhokisi okukhetha lezihloko ezijulileyo kuba yizinhlu zokuhlola.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: KuPivotal Tracker, vula ithebhu ethi MORE yephrojekthi ukhethe Export CSV (loba ukhethe izindaba ukhethe Bulk Actions, CSV), ubusunamathisela i-CSV. Isimo ngasinye sendaba siba luhlu lezindaba ziba ngamakhadi, lohlobo lwazo lamalebula, abanikazi, ocelayo, amalanga, amazwana, imisebenzi lokuvimbayo; i-Estimate iba ngamaphuzu endaba lemijikelezo iba ngama-sprint.
import-board-instruction-plane: KuPlane, vula Workspace Settings, khetha Exports, thumela amaphrojekthi njenge-JSON, CSV loba Excel ulande ifayili ye-.zip, ubusukhetha leyo fayili, loba ifayili eyodwa ephakathi kwayo, loba unamathisele i-JSON loba i-CSV. Izimo ziba yizinhlu, amaphrojekthi aba yimizila, lezindaba ziba ngamakhadi lophawu lwazo, umzali, abanikwe umsebenzi, amalebula, amalanga, amalinki lamazwana; okuqakathekileyo, isilinganiso, umjikelezo lemojuli kuba yizikhala zakho. Ukuthumela kukaPlane kakulazincazelo loba okunamathiselweyo, ngakho kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: KuQuire, vula imenyu yephrojekthi ukhethe Export CSV, ubusunamathisela i-CSV. Izimo ziba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, lemisebenzi yawo emincane njengamakhadi angabantwana, abanikwe umsebenzi, amathegi njengamalebula, amalanga okuqala, okucina lokuqediwa, incazelo lokuqakathekileyo njengesikhala sakho. Amazwana lokunamathiselweyo kakukho ku-CSV kaQuire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: KuRedmine, vula ama-Issues ephrojekthi, khetha Also available in: CSV phansi kohlu, khetha amakholamu (All columns, le-Description) uthumele, ubusunamathisela i-CSV. URedmine uqamba amakholamu ngolimi lwakho, ngakho beka ulimi lwakho lube yisiNgisi ku-My account ungakathumeli. Isimo ngasinye siba luhlu lezindaba ziba ngamakhadi, le-tracker njengelebula, onikwe umsebenzi, umbhali, amalanga, umsebenzi ongumzali lezindaba ezihambelanayo; okuqakathekileyo, isigaba, inguqulo eqondiweyo, isikhathi esilinganiselweyo, i-% Done lezikhala zakho kuba yizikhala zakho.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: KuSuper Productivity, vula Settings, ubusuvula Sync & Backup, khetha Export Data unamathisele okuphakathi kwefayili ye-sp-backup .json. Iphrojekthi ngayinye iba ngumzila lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi ku-To Do, In Progress, Backlog loba Done, lamanothi ayo, amathegi, ilanga lokucina, isikhathi esisetshenzisiweyo lemisebenzi emincane; imisebenzi esengobweni yomlando iba ngamakhadi asengobweni yomlando.
import-board-instruction-taiga: KuTaiga, vula Admin > Project > Export ulande ukuthululwa kwephrojekthi (vula ifayili ye-.json.gz kuqala), ubusunamathisela i-JSON yayo. Izimo zezindaba zabasebenzisi ziba yizinhlu, izindaba zabasebenzisi ziba ngamakhadi lemisebenzi yazo njengemisebenzi emincane, ama-epic lezindaba athola imizila yawo, njalo ama-sprint, amathegi, amazwana lezimpawu zakho kuza lakho. Okunamathiselweyo kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: KuTasks.org, vula Settings, Backups ukhethe Export tasks, ubusunamathisela okuphakathi kwefayili leyo ye-.json. Izinhlu ziba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, lamanothi ayo, amathegi, amalanga, amazwana lemisebenzi emincane; imisebenzi eqediweyo igcina ilanga layo lokuqediwa, lokuqakathekileyo kuba yisikhala sakho.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namathisela umphumela we-task export: uluhlu lwe-JSON kumbe umsebenzi owodwa emgqeni ngamunye. Imisebenzi ephelileyo iya ku-Done, project le-priority kuba ngamalebula, annotations iba yimibono, kuthi depends ibe yikuncika emisebenzini evimbayo.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: KuTeamwork.com, gcwalisa ithempulethi ye-Excel yokungenisa imisebenzi (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) uyilondoloze njenge-.xlsx, ubusukhetha leyo fayili. Izinhlu zemisebenzi ziba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi; umsebenzi oqala ngo -, # loba > uba ngumsebenzi omncane womsebenzi ongaphezu kwawo (--, ## loba >> izinga elilodwa ngaphansi). Abanikwe umsebenzi, amalanga lamathegi kugcina izindawo zakho; i-Priority, i-Estimated time le-Complete kuba yizikhala zakho.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: KuTickTick, vula Settings, Account, Backup & Import wenze isipele, ubusunamathisela ifayili ye-CSV. Uluhlu ngalunye lweTickTick luba ngumzila lamakholamu alo aba yizinhlu; imisebenzi igcina amathegi ayo, amalanga, uluhlu lokuhlola, okuqakathekileyo lemisebenzi emincane.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namathisela ifayela le-todo.txt: umsebenzi owodwa emzileni ngamunye, ngendlela uhlelo lwe-todo.txt lezinhlelo ezihambelanayo ezibhala ngayo. Imisebenzi ephelileyo ("x") iya kweseziphelile, +project lo-@context kuba ngamalebula, (A) iba yilebula yokuqakatheka, kuthi due: lo-t: kube zinsuku zokucina lezokuqala.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: KuVikunja, vula Settings, khetha Data Export ulande ifayili ye-.zip ekuthumelela yona, ubusukhetha leyo fayili, loba unamathisele i-data.json ephakathi kwayo. Amabhakede eKanban aba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, lamalebula awo, abanikwe umsebenzi, amalanga, incazelo, izinhlu zemisebenzi njengezinhlu zokuhlola lamazwana; okuqakathekileyo, iphesenti eliqediweyo lokuqediweyo kuba yizikhala zakho. Okunamathiselweyo kakungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-wrike: KuWrike, thumela iphrojekthi loba ifolda ku-Excel, loba ugcwalise ithempulethi ye-Excel yokungenisa kaWrike, ubusukhetha leyo fayili ye-.xlsx. Imigqa yefolda leyephrojekthi iba yimizila, i-Status iba yizinhlu lemisebenzi iba ngamakhadi, le-Key yawo, umsebenzi ongumzali, abanikwe umsebenzi, amalanga okuqala lokucina, okuncikileyo lencazelo; i-Priority, i-Duration lamanye amakholamu aba yizikhala zakho.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Namathisela i-JSON ekhishwe kuluhlu lwe-ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Izigaba ziba yizinhlu, izinto zibe ngamakhadi.
import-file-label: Khetha ifayili yokuthumela, loba unamathisele umbhalo wayo ngaphansi:
import-members-map: Ibhodi lakho elingenisiweyo lilamalunga athile. Sicela uxhumanise amalunga ofuna ukuwangenisa labasebenzisi bakho
import-members-map-note: Qaphela: Amalunga angaxhumaniswanga azabelwa umsebenzisi wamanje.
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bagcine njengabasebenzisi abamelayo ngamabizo abo, ukuze bahlanganiswe labasebenzisi beqiniso ngemva
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Umzila ngamunye ongenziwa yikungenisa (iphrojekthi, ifolda loba uluhlu lwethuluzi) uba yibhodi yawo. Amakhadi angabazali lokuncikileyo phakathi kwalawo mabhodi kubhalwe embikweni wokungenisa.
import-report-description: Ibhodi lenziwe, kodwa ezinye izingxenye zefayela azikwazanga ukulethwa. Umbiko ofanayo ugcinwe ku-Iphaneli yomlawuli → Izinkinga → Ukubuyisela.
import-too-large: Ifayela likhulu kakhulu ukuthi lingeniswe kanye kanye. Lehlukanise libe ngamafayela amancane, ngokwesibonelo ngephrojekthi kumbe ngosuku, ubusungenisa ngalinye.
instance-desc: Wonke umsebenzisi ongenileyo kule WeKan angalibona leli bhodi. Alitshengiswa loba nini ebantwini abangangeni. Ngabantu abengezwe ebhodini kuphela abangalihlela.
invalid-file: Nxa ibizo lefayela lingasebenzi, ukulayisha loba ukutshintsha ibizo kuyakhanselwa.
invalid-year: Umnyaka awusebenzi. Sicela ubhale amanani amane wonke, isibonelo 2026.
list-permissions-desc: Lokho indima ngayinye engakwenza kulolu luhlu, ngaphezu kwalokho okuvunyelwa yibhodi. Abaphathi bebhodi bangahlela ngaso sonke isikhathi.
muted-info: Awusoze waziswe ngaluphi utshintsho kuleli bhodi
name: Ibizo
notification-delivery-layout-clear: Kuhlelwe kuhle: ibhodi, ngubani, ikhadi ngombhalo ogqamileyo
password-change-required-text: Lesi sizinda manje sidinga amaphasiwedi okungenani ezinhlamvu ezingu-__min__, kanti eyakho imfitshane. Khetha ende ukuze uqhubeke. Ngemva kwalokho wonke amaseshini e-akhawunti yakho ayakhutshwa, njalo ungena futhi ngephasiwedi entsha.
password-length-from-environment: Inani elisethwe endaweni yeseva liyasebenza; ukulondoloza lapha kuyalidlula.
password-length-report-desc: Ama-akhawunti angene ngephasiwedi emfitshane kulobude obuncane. Yisiphequluli kuphela esaziyo ukuthi iphasiwedi ide kangakanani, ngakho sibika emfitshane ngemva kokungena; iphasiwedi lobude bayo kakuze baphume kuso. Kulungisiwe yisikhathi lapho iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti yaguqulwa khona - i-akhawunti engena futhi ngephasiwedi emfitshane iboniswa futhi njengemfitshane kakhulu.
password-min-length-description: Ukungena ngephasiwedi emfitshane kuyabhalwa ngezansi. Ukungena kakuze kwaliwe ngenxa yalokho.
password-min-length-enforce-description: Iphasiwedi entsha emfitshane iyaliwa, njalo i-akhawunti engena ngephasiwedi emfitshane kumele iyiguqule ngaphambi kwakho konke okunye. Ukuyiguqula kukhupha wonke amaseshini e-akhawunti. Amaphasiwedi e-LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS le-Sandstorm ngawomnikezeli wawo, njalo kawahlolwa.
password-pwned: Le phasiwedi isivele yavela ekuvuzeni kwedatha. Khetha enye.
password-same-as-username: Iphasiwedi akumelanga ibe libizo lomsebenzisi kumbe ikheli le-imeyili.
password-too-short: Iphasiwedi kumele ibe lobude obungabi ngaphansi kwezinhlamvu ezingu-__min__.
preview-pdf-not-supported: Idivayisi yakho ayikusekeli ukubuka kuqala i-PDF. Zama ukuyilanda esikhundleni salokho.
private-desc: Leli bhodi liyimfihlo. Abantu abengezwe ebhodini kuphela abangalibona futhi balihlele.
public-desc: Leli bhodi ngelomphakathi. Libonakala kuloba ngubani olesixhumanisi futhi lizavela kuzinjini zokusesha ezifana le-Google. Abantu abengezwe ebhodini kuphela abangahlela.
r-add-actinguser-member: Faka umsebenzisi owaqalisa umthetho lo njengelunga
r-blocks-conflict: Lo mthetho utshintshile ubusahlela. Layisha kabutsha umthetho olondoloziweyo ungakalondolozi.
r-blocks-help: Xhumanisa isiqalisi esisodwa lesenzo esisodwa. Donsa amabhuloki usuka ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Sebenzisa isihleli sefomu ukuthola okukhethwayo okuthuthukileyo.
r-blocks-invalid: Xhumanisa isiqalisi esisodwa kuphela lesenzo esisodwa. Susa amabhuloki angaxhumananga loba engeziweyo ungakalondolozi.
r-blocks-permission: Imvumo yomphathi webhodi iyadingeka ukuhlela imithetho.
r-blocks-unavailable: Idatha yomthetho kayitholakali. Sebenzisa isihleli sefomu ukuhlola lo mthetho.
r-cron-invalid: Uhlelo lwe-cron lulezigaba ezinhlanu: umzuzu ihora ilanga inyanga ilanga leviki.
r-email-members-hint: Ilunga lebhodi elengezwe kuluhlu lingena ku-Ku njenge-@username njalo lithunyelwa ekhelini le-imeyili lalelo lunga. Amanye amakheli e-imeyili angabhalwa ku-Ku.
r-import-paste: Namathisela imithetho ekhishiweyo (JSON loba CSV) loba imilayo ye-Trello Butler lapha
r-import-trello: Ngenisa imithetho kusuka ku-Trello Butler (ngomzamo ongcono)
r-import-trello-note: Okukhitshwe ebhodini le-Trello akulamithetho ye-Butler. Namathisela umbhalo womlayo we-Butler lapha ukuze umadanise ingxenye esekelwayo; imigqa engamadaniswanga iyabikwa.
r-import-workflow-note: Ngenisa ukuhamba komsebenzi okubonakalayo okukhitshwe ku-n8n loba ku-Node-RED. Amanodi esiqalisi/esenzo abonakalayo amadaniswa lemithetho ye-WeKan; amanodi angamadaniswanga ayabikwa.
r-import-wrike-workflow-done: Indlela yomsebenzi kaWrike "__name__": __lists__ uluhlu/izinhlu lo-__rules__ umthetho/imithetho kungeziwe, __skipped__ ingxenye/izingxenye kakufundwanga
r-insert-variable: Faka okuguquguqukayo endaweni yombhalo oyikhethe okokucina:
r-rules-not-shown: Ngabaphathi bebhodi kuphela ababona Imithetho yaleli bhodi.
r-trigger-vars-hint: Izindawo zohlu, umzila, isihloko, uhlu lokuhlola lomsebenzisi ziyamukela le-{creator}, {assignees}, {members} kanye le-{customField:Name}. Amanani azo afundwa ekhadini nxa kuhlolwa umthetho.
r-vars-people-hint: Njalo: {creator}, {assignees}, {members} (amabizo abasebenzisi embhalweni, amakheli e-imeyili endaweni yomamukeli) kanye le-{customField:Field name}. Lokhu kuyasebenza lasemabizweni amalunga, izinhlu lemizila yezinye izenzo.
r-when-a-card-title-or-description-conta: Nxa isihloko loba incazelo yekhadi ilalo
r-workflow-help: Hudulela isiqalisi lesenzo kumakhi, ubusengeza umthetho. Hudulela isenzo emthethweni okhona ukuze utshintshe lokho okwenzayo.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Indlela yomsebenzi kaWrike luhlu lwezimo, ngasinye siseqenjini elithi Active, Completed, Deferred loba Cancelled. Ukuthumela kubhala izinhlu zale bhodi njengendlela eyodwa, eqanjwe ngebhodi, ku-JSON leyo i-API kaWrike eyibuyisela izindlela zomsebenzi: dala leyo ndlela yomsebenzi kuWrike ungakangenisi ukuthumela kwe-Excel kaWrike kwebhodi, ukuze izimo zayo zisetshenziswe. Ukungenisa kufunda leyo JSON enamathiselwe ngaphezulu, evela kuWeKan loba ku-GET /workflows kaWrike, kubhodi elikhethiweyo: isimo esingelaluhlu siba luhlu, njalo umthetho uphawula ikhadi liqediwe nxa lihanjiswa esimeni se-Completed loba se-Cancelled, lingaqediwanga esimeni se-Active loba se-Deferred. Imithetho kaWrike yokuzenzakalela ingeke ithunyelwe isuka kuWrike.
recovery-report-desc: Izenzo ezizenzakalelayo zokuphepha lokulungisa idatha: ukuthola ukonakala, izipele zedatha yombhalo, ukubuyisela, ukuthutha futhi kusuka ku-MongoDB, lokulungisa ngokuzenzakalela isizindalwazi esikhukhumele.
restore-all-skipped-wip-limit: Amakhadi angu-__count__ kawabuyiselwanga: izinhlu zawo sezifike emikhawulweni yazo we-WIP. Wabuyisele ngalinye ukuze ukhethe olunye uluhlu.
restore-card-no-list-with-room: Zonke izinhlu kulelibhodi sezifike emkhawulweni wazo we-WIP. Phakamisa umkhawulo, kumbe uthuthe kumbe uyise esiphaleni amakhadi, ukuze ubuyisele lelikhadi.
restore-card-wip-limit-reached: Uluhlu __list__ selufike emkhawulweni walo we-WIP. Buyisela ikhadi kolunye uluhlu:
scrum-backlog-help: Hlela umsebenzi ngezinga lemisebenzi elindileyo. Nika amakhadi ku-sprint ehleliweyo loba esebenzayo.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Khansela le sprint? Amakhadi ayo azagcina ubulunga bawo aze anikwe kabutsha.
scrum-confirm-close: Vala le sprint ulondoloze imiphumela yayo? Amakhadi angaqediwanga azahanjiswa endaweni ekhethiweyo.
scrum-daily-empty: Kakulakubonwa kwansuku zonke okubhalelwe le sprint.
scrum-daily-observations: Ububanzi bomsebenzi bansuku zonke lomsebenzi oseleyo (okubonwayo)
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Okubonwe kokuqala okubhaliweyo kwelanga ngalinye le-UTC; amalanga angekho atshiyiwe. Okubonwayo kakubhali konke ukutshintsha loba izamba zokucina kwelanga. Izilinganiso ezingaziwayo kaziso zikazero.
scrum-daily-observations-help: Ibha ngayinye itshengisa okubonwe kokuqala okubhaliweyo kwelanga le-UTC, ngesikhathi esitshengisiweyo. Amalanga angekho atshiyiwe. Lokhu okubonwayo kakubhali konke ukutshintsha loba kutshengise izamba zokucina kwelanga. Izilinganiso ezingaziwayo kaziso zikazero. Sebenzisa isenzo esithi Thumela salesi sigaba ekuboneni kwansuku zonke; isenzo esithi Thumela sebha yamathuluzi sithumela imiphumela ye-sprint.
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Umphathi webhodi angakubuyisela emuva loba agcine ibhodi linjalo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ ku-__total__ izinguquko zabhalwa, __pending__ kazibhalwanga, njalo __conflicted__ zatshintshwa ngomunye umuntu selokhu.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Gcina yonke imibhalo injalo khathesi, kuhlanganisa lezinguquko umsebenzi omileyo osuzibhalile?
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Ukubuyisela emuva kubuyisela yonke imibhalo etshintshiweyo njengoba yayinjalo ngaphambili; kunikwa kuphela nxa kungekho omunye otshintshe leyo mibhalo selokhu. Ukugcina ibhodi linjalo kususa umsebenzi omileyo njalo kakutshintshi mibhalo. Kunoma yiyiphi indlela, kubhalwa ku-Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Ukubuyisela emuva, ukuphinda loba ukubuyisela kwezinguquko ze-Scrum kwema ngenxa yokungqubuzana. Ukuhlela kwe-Scrum kule bhodi kuvinjiwe kuze kuxazululwe.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Ikhadi lifana lamakhadi angaphezu kwelilodwa kule bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Ikhadi lingelelinye ibhodi njalo latshiywa linjalo: __reference__
scrum-import-into-board-done: Ukuhlela kwe-Scrum kungenisiwe njalo kwabhalwa eMlandweni.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Khetha ukuthumela kwebhodi likaWeKan loba ifayili yokudlulisela ye-Scrum. Ama-sprint lokukhutshwa le bhodi esela kona kuyaxhumaniswa, kakuphindwa. Amakhadi afaniswa nge-ID, loba ngenombolo yekhadi lesihloko; amakhadi angafanani ayabhalwa njalo atshiywe enjalo. Bona kuqala ukuze ubone okuzatshintsha.
scrum-import-pending: Ukungenisa kwe-Scrum kakuqediwanga. Ukuhlela kwe-Scrum lokuthumela imibiko kakutholakali.
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Kakulalutho okumele kutshintshwe: le bhodi isilokhu kuhlela.
scrum-import-preview-releases: Ukukhutshwa: __created__ okutsha, __matched__ sekuvele kukule bhodi, __skipped__ kakungeniswanga
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Ama-sprint: __created__ amatsha, __matched__ asevele ekule bhodi, __skipped__ kawangeniswanga
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: I-sprint loba ukukhutshwa kufana lokungaphezu kokukodwa kule bhodi: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: I-sprint, ukukhutshwa loba umcimbi kakukwazanga ukungeniswa: __reference__
scrum-partial-report: Umbiko oyingxenye: kuphela amakhadi onikwe wona khathesi afakiweyo.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Le sprint iphethe ingxenye kuphela yesithombe sokuqala.
scrum-releases-select-help: Ikhadi lingaba sekukhutshweni okunengi. Bamba u-Ctrl (u-Cmd kuMac) ukukhetha okungaphezu kokukodwa; kusule konke ukususa ikhadi kukho konke ukukhutshwa.
scrum-report-help: Imibiko igcina izilinganiso ezivela ezithombeni ze-sprint. Izilinganiso ezingaziwayo zibalwa ngokwehlukileyo; kaziso izilinganiso zikazero. Qathanisa ijubane kuphela phakathi kwezilinganisi zesilinganiso lezinqubomgomo ezifanayo.
scrum-scope-history: Ububanzi bomsebenzi lomsebenzi oseleyo, inguquko ngayinye
scrum-scope-history-help: Kwakhiwe kutsha ngembali yebhodi kusukela ekuqaleni kwesikhathi somsebenzi: umugqa owodwa wenguquko ngayinye kumakhadi esikhathi somsebenzi, ezilinganisweni kumbe emsebenzini ophelileyo.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Imbali ayibuyiseli umfanekiso wesimo salesi sikhathi somsebenzi uqobo: ezinye inguquko zenziwa zingabhalwanga embalini, ngakho amanani la awaphelelanga.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Kwenelisiwe ukufunda inguquko zokuqala kuphela; ukwakha kutsha akuphelelanga.
submit-on-enter-description: Nxa kuvuliwe, ukucindezela u-Enter kulondoloza isihloko sekhadi, incazelo labanye abahleli abasemgqeni; u-Shift+Enter ufaka umugqa omutsha. Nxa kuvaliwe, u-Ctrl/Cmd+Enter uyalondoloza njalo u-Enter ufaka umugqa omutsha.
text-contains-trigger-description: Kuyahambelana nxa ikhadi lisungulwa, kumbe isihloko loba incazelo yalo iguqulwa, njalo umbhalo omutsha ulalokhu (akulani mahluko phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezinkulu lezincane).
title: Isihloko
tracking-info: Uzaziswa ngazo zonke izinguquko kulawo makhadi ohileleke kuwo njengomdali loba ilunga.
watching-info: Uzaziswa ngazo zonke izinguquko kuleli bhodi
webhook-payload-description: Lokho okuthunyelwa ngama-webhook aphumayo (Rocket.Chat, Slack, ...). Okuzenzakalelayo kugcina isilungiselelo esizuzwe njengelifa; nxa kungabekwanga lutho, ama-webhook athumela lokho abelokhu ekuthumela.
webhook-payload-field-people: Ilunga loba onikwe umsebenzi okukhulunywa ngaye
